method:
(built at run time from authoritative records; evidence URL and
official time stored with every event):
  nse_filing                NSE corporate announcements: dissemination time to the
                            second (recent window and a 2025 results window)
  bse_filing                BSE announcements (attempted; the API refuses
                            automated access intermittently -> recorded)
  rbi, sebi                 official RSS releases with exact times (material only)
  india_policy              PIB (Government of India) releases (material only)
  us_policy_whitehouse      White House presidential actions / news on tariffs,
                            sanctions and trade (exact times)
  us_policy_federal_register Federal Register presidential documents on tariffs /
                            sanctions (date only)
  fed                       Federal Reserve press releases (exact) and FOMC target
                            changes (FRED DFEDTARU, date only)
  crude, gold, currency     Brent, gold and USD/INR daily moves >= 2 sd of the
                            prior 60 days (Yahoo; date only)

Providers: google_news, gdelt, marketaux, alphavantage, newsapi,
publisher_rss, official_rss. Keyed providers use MARKETAUX_API_TOKEN,
ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY, NEWSAPI_KEY from the environment (never printed);
without a key they are UNTESTABLE_NOT_CONFIGURED - never "missed". The
exposed NewsAPI key from Git history is never used.
status_definitions:
DETECTED                    a VERIFIED, unambiguous article exists in the event window
  AMBIGUOUS                   only weak verified articles: market roundups / multi-company
                              headlines, or a first report more than 24 h after an exact
                              official time (probably a different story). Counted as tested;
                              strict recall treats it as not detected, lenient as detected
  MISSED                      the provider was queried successfully and has none
  UNTESTABLE_NO_HISTORY       the event is older than the provider's history
  UNTESTABLE_NOT_CONFIGURED   no credential: the provider was not queried
  SOURCE_OF_RECORD            the provider is the event's own official source
  OUTAGE / RATE_LIMITED       the query failed: not a miss, reported separately

Only DETECTED, AMBIGUOUS and MISSED count as tested. Missing history is
never a pass.

Precision (article level): unambiguous verified articles / candidate
articles the provider returned for the event's subject. Low precision means
much of what a provider returns about a company is not about the event.

Segments: indian_company (NSE / BSE filings), indian_macro (RBI, SEBI,
Government of India), international_policy (Fed, White House, Federal
Register), commodity_currency (crude, gold, USD/INR).
